test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) 5 2 # 3 % 2 3 & 8 $ 7 8 # 9 5 @ 6 & 4 9 $ 3 6 # 7 5 $ 8 % 6 2 & 8 2 % 3 8 @ 9 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the right?
solution:
The **given arrangement **is - (Left) 5 2 # 3 % 2 3 & 8 $ 7 8 # 9 5 @ 6 & 4 9 $ 3 6 # 7 5 $ 8 % 6 2 & 8 2 % 3 8 @ 9 (Right)

Now if we drop all the symbols from the above arrangement, we get-

(Left) 5 2 3 2 3 8 7 8 9 5 6 4 9 3 6 7 5 8 6 2 8 2 3 8 9 (Right)

Therefore, the **seventh element from the right is '6'**.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
